d: Eli and Cassie, always had a... complicated relationship. They bicker, bite and snarl at each other, but despite that this never stopped their friendship to blossom. They have always worked side-by-side, from university labs to their isolated special division at the company. But when they're tasked to develop the elixir to immortality, their experiment goes haywire - leaves them with a blessing instead of wounds. Come and follow their journey as they test the limits of their newfound power and deepen their friendship into something even more.
